channel.title: Journal of the AI Universe: Daily AI News Updates
channel.description: Charting the universe of AI with the evidence behind it. The latest AI news across every dimension of human civilisation.

item.title: Journal of the AI Universe: 29 October 2026
item.description:

item.description:

item.description:

item.title: Journal of the AI Universe: 24 October 2026
item.description:
• AI flagging of pulmonary embolism on CT raised response-team activation from 9.2% to 84.5% in 424 patients
  • Point-of-care autonomous AI eye exams brought screening to 98–99.5% in 397 young people with diabetes
  • A 7-tesla fMRI study finds language models poorly capture how word roles shape sentence meaning in the brain
  • An audit shows some AI cooling savings come from benchmark weights, not better control of real plants
  • Outside auditors found 6–25% of OpenAI's internal agent traffic was not monitored during a three-week review

item.title: Journal of the AI Universe: 23 October 2026
item.description:
• A Nature study used cryo-EM and an AI-designed scaffold to show how Andes hantavirus grips the human PCDH1 receptor
  • In 179 teenagers, a stronger EEG response to peer rejection predicted later depression severity in those already depressed
  • A benchmark on grids up to 70,000 buses finds fast CPU and GPU solvers match ML shortcuts for speed with far higher accuracy
  • A Harvard study of 718 firms finds AI coding tools raise code volume but not completed work, held back by reviews
  • CureBay raises about ₹100 crore for AI-supported rural clinics and plans to enter Andhra Pradesh and Telangana

item.title: Journal of the AI Universe: 22 October 2026
item.description:
• A multicentre randomised trial found AI navigation cut pneumothorax after CT-guided lung biopsy from 23.9% to 12.7%
  • An independent 17-hospital audit found a cleared pulmonary-embolism AI detected 86.8% of clots, below its clearance benchmarks
  • Microsoft Research reports a proof of the 31-year-old KLS conjecture found with AI, independently checked and machine-verified
  • Two Nature papers report protein-cutting enzymes designed from scratch, with 36% of 135 metalloprotease designs active
  • Google's $15 billion Visakhapatnam AI hub will back Indian-language tools with Sarvam AI, first phase due in 2028

item.title: Journal of the AI Universe: 21 October 2026
item.description:
• Anthropic is reported in talks with Nscale for a second 460 MW West Virginia data centre worth about $45 billion
  • Schaeffler opens a Taicang factory where six humanoids assemble actuators for other humanoids
  • Autonomous AI agents run by a criminal targeted more than 1,200 company websites with almost no human help
  • Psychologist-checked AI feedback in online CBT nearly matched human therapists for social anxiety in a 263-person trial
  • T-Mobile reports 16% faster peak-hour downloads in New York with Ericsson AI-RAN

item.title: Journal of the AI Universe: 20 October 2026
item.description:

  • Quantinuum sets an error-correction world record: 99.9995% logical fidelity on Helios
  • Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft end to end in 27 hours with no human help
  • Samsung agrees to use TSMC's 3nm process for Nvidia's NVHBM base dies
  • CERT-In warns AI agents under evaluation read Indian firms' live records undetected
